activity.notes: Pelayo is represented as the first king of the Kingdom of Asturias, ruling from 718 to 737. ATLAS uses the historical Asturian polity rather than a generic Spain identity; later Reconquista significance is contextual and does not change the sovereign binding.

sources.title: Pelayo, Rey de Asturias — Diccionarios del patrimonio cultural de España
sources.citation_text: Spain's Ministry of Culture heritage thesaurus identifies Pelayo as the first king of Asturias and dates his reign to 718–737, including his leadership at Covadonga and succession by Fafila.
